name: Bastl
description: Bastl Instruments is an independent, family-run manufacturer based in Brno, Czech Republic. Founded in 2013 by Václav Peloušek (aka Toyota Vangelis), the company produces eurorack modules, analog/digital synthesizers, and portable sound boxes designed for creative, hands-on exploration. Bastl focuses on ethical, local manufacturing, open-source designs, and community engagement through workshops and live events.
